Guides

Practical guides for a Bitcoin treasury.

Written by the people who do the work. Each guide is practical enough for a finance team to act on, and honest about the trade-offs.

Guide 1 · Faizal Abdillah

Bitcoin treasury policy: what to put in it

A one-page policy your board can read in five minutes: purpose, allocation limits, buying method, custody, approvals, reporting and review. This guide shows what each section covers and what to decide.

Guide 2 · Faizal Abdillah

Accounting and audit for Bitcoin holdings

What your auditor will ask and what evidence to prepare: control, existence, valuation, accounting treatment and disclosure. A practical guide that leaves conclusions to your auditor.

Guide 3 · Ricky Saif

Getting board approval: a checklist

Prepare the questions, risks and decision paper a board expects. Five stages, each ending with something written, so approval becomes a normal governance step.

Guide 4 · Ricky Saif

Running a leadership education session

Plan a 90-minute session that ends with next steps and named owners. A practical agenda for leaders who need to understand the problem before they decide anything.

Guide 5 · Banitama

Custody options: multisig vs custodian

How your company holds Bitcoin matters more than what it holds. This guide compares self-custody with shared approvals and regulated custodians, and helps you choose for your risk level.
